findings.title: Bounded firing waits for the entire pass before polling
findings.description: `run()` uses blocking `subprocess.run()`. Meanwhile, `deploy/mt-run:129` waits until the service exits. Consequently, journal polling and the early-stop logic cannot execute while the pass runs—the cutover still waits through unbounded backfill. Start the service non-blockingly, then monitor its journal. Add a test that exercises the real wrapper’s blocking behavior rather than mocking `run()` to return immediately.

findings.title: Restricted sudo grants root execution of an operator-controlled script
findings.description:
`MT_INSTALL`, granted passwordless root access on line 13, executes a script from the operator’s development checkout. The operator can modify that script and execute arbitrary commands as root; restricting its arguments to `--ref` provides no protection. Install a root-owned helper outside operator-writable directories, and ensure its privileged inputs cannot introduce arbitrary executable code.

Tests could not run: the available Python interpreter has no `pytest` module.
